name: k-raildex
description: 한국철도도감 (K-Raildex) — 대한민국 철도 노선·역·운행 계통·계획 정보 (DB 원천 재구축)

scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml up -d --wait db s3
scripts.stack:up: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml $( [ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env ) --profile app $( grep -qE '^CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=.+' .env 2>/dev/null && echo --profile tunnel ) up -d --build --wait
scripts.stack:down: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml $( [ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env ) --profile app $( grep -qE '^CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=.+' .env 2>/dev/null && echo --profile tunnel ) down
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml $( [ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env ) --profile app $( grep -qE '^CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN=.+' .env 2>/dev/null && echo --profile tunnel ) logs -f --tail=100
